Cherish The Ladies, X:11

Variation on version 10, begining of Part 3 (dcd instead of d3 and bar 5 of part 5 (DFA dgf instead of DFA ~g2 f .

This version is more fluid.

I also updated the composer who is supposed to be Walter Jackson according to some sources; This asumption fits pretty well the structure of the tune, which remind me of others jigs of this old period 1750-1780.
